description: debug: check the bus and runner with bounded diagnostics; use agent-bus may-send <name> to check your own permission
author: Serg Parf and agent-bus contributors

hello.help: Greet a name; hello smoke returns hello, smoke

env.help: Show names with private values masked; AGENT_BUS_TOKEN is always masked

help.help: Describe methods; use agent-bus may-send <name> for your own permission check

echo.help: Return the delivered envelope fields as JSON, never process credentials

roles.help: Return delivered roles and their daemon origin; roles cannot be supplied in the body

ping.help: Return receive/answer Unix times and the debug version

sleep.help: Wait up to the message deadline; sleep 0.1 returns slept seconds

fail.help: Return error: debug failure <code> and write a fixed stderr diagnostic; fail 7

crash.help: Crash debug with SIGSEGV, no core dump; the runner restarts it; no answer is possible

sandbox.help: Return observed uid/gid, process restrictions, limits and path writability; no host or network probes

selftest.help: Check ping, echo and slow/error answers locally, plus own KV and lock via the bus; each step returns ✅ or ❌; at most one selftest at a time

doctor.help: Ask local server-info, systemd, logwatch and Telegram as debug; ACL refusals stay refused; unavailable checks are named

big.help: Return exactly KB*1024 ASCII bytes; big 1 returns 1024 bytes

unicode.help: Return fixed Cyrillic, emoji, newline, tab and control-byte text for escaping checks
